column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB links the verse to verse 2 as one sentence.
“In the midst of the tent curtain” is rendered “within tent curtains.”
“In your heart” is rendered “in your mind.”

NASB renders the singulars (“plant it … it will dwell”) as plurals and supplies “in their own place”; “sons of injustice” becomes “the wicked.”
“Appointed judges” is rendered “commanded judges to be,” and “He tells you” as “declares to you.”
“From your inward parts” is rendered “from you,” and “offspring” as “descendant.”
